Iteration: 1 - Confirm Hold Endpoint
Request Description
Convert a hold into a booking and allocate resources. This endpoint creates a new booking using the details recorded within the hold. The booking is initially created with status ``pending``. Resources are allocated via the scheduling service. If allocation fails, the hold remains pending and an HTTP error is raised. On success, the hold is marked as confirmed. Args: hold_id: Identifier of the hold to confirm. payload: Optional payload containing client or additional information (unused in this simplified implementation). db: Injected database session. Returns: The newly created booking as a serialisable Pydantic model.
